arms.down_perm: s- on P permuted among P (recruit.shuffled with P as the pool, seeds 0..19), clipped: the same turn-down values on other subcomponents that are on
arms.down_pool: clip(g0(x) + s-) with s- kept only on the pool P = alive subcomponents with m0 >= 0.1 (the subcomponents on enough at the trigger to be turned down; every s <= -m0, so all s <= -0.1 are in P)
arms.mean, mean_W0: m1 and m0 for every window: amendment 1's, repeated (the additivity grid)
arms.mismatch: window x gets g1(pi(x)) at the trigger, pi a derangement of the held-out windows (recruit.derangement seeds 0..4); mismatch_W0: g0(pi(x)), its reference
arms.pile: clip(g0(x) + s) at position `half` of Pile rows ('val', 0, 64) cut to the task's window length, W0's gates elsewhere (reported)
arms.resid: clip(g1(x) - s): the state's own values with the fixed change removed, the input-varying part kept
arms.resid_held: clip(g1(x) - s_held): the same with the held-out mean change removed (a purely input-varying remainder; reported)
arms.resid_noclip: g1(x) - s, not clipped (the grid's missing cell; values below 0 flip a subcomponent's sign)
arms.trig, shared, noclip: g1(x); clip(g0(x) + s); g0(x) + s: amendment 2's, repeated (the gate)
arms.up, down: clip(g0(x) + s+), clip(g0(x) + s-); also not clipped (up_noclip, down_noclip)
arms.up_perm: s+ permuted among the alive subcomponents (seeds 0..19), clipped

blind_to.all: trigger position (Pile arm aside) and held-out windows only; one model, three tasks
blind_to.halves: the shuffles keep each matrix's values (and the pool), so they cannot see whether the split across matrices matters; down_perm cannot separate identity when P is not much larger than the strongly turned-down set (n_down_strong / n_pool reported)
blind_to.mismatch: the level is blind to a leak that carries a per-window strength (it averages out over the derangement): c_own vs c_donor reads that; the level mixes in what mismatching costs with no update (mismatch_W0)
blind_to.resid: a leak that acts only together with the fixed change (the grid's v1 cell, 1 - R_resid_noclip, reads that); the clip removes negative remainders (windows that switched less than average)

expected.W0: with no update (g1 = g0, s = 0) resid, resid_noclip, resid_held, up, down, down_pool, the perms and pile all read 0; mismatch reads mismatch_W0, not 0; the per-window gains a(x) average to rho_trig x gap exactly (checked)
expected.pile_ratio: low-confidence guess <= 0.3 (the change raises the target in context)
expected.repeat: trig, shared, noclip equal amendment 2's to 1e-6; mean and mean_W0 equal amendment 1's (0.92/0.91, 0.94/0.94, 1.11/1.15; 0.11/0.10, 0.24/0.24, 0.27/0.29)

gate.if_fail: stop; no new arm is run
gate.rule: G1 as E18; and |rho - amendment 2| <= 1e-06 for trig, shared and noclip on every task and seed

hypothesis: H: after a narrow fine-tune, the switching effect at the trigger is carried by one change to Gamma's importance values that is (a) the same for every input, (b) specific to which subcomponents receive it, and (c) enough on its own: the part of the updated model's values that varies with the input adds nothing. A leak is the failure of (c). Every scored arm below is one H can fail

measurements.R_mismatch: mean over the 5 derangements of R
measurements.R_x: rho_x / rho_trig, rho = recovery (lo - L00) / (L01 - L00) on the held-out windows, as amendments 1 and 2
measurements.c_own, c_donor: per window, the masked gain b(x) = lo(x) - lo00(x) under the mismatched values; a(x) the same under its own values. c_own = corr(b, a), c_donor = corr(b, a o pi) (the donor's own gain); mean over derangements. c_null = corr(a, a o pi), the chance level
measurements.grid: the effect of s at three backgrounds, if effects add: none (R_mean - R_mean_W0), W0's own variation (R_noclip), the state's own variation (1 - R_resid_noclip)
measurements.pile_ratio: (lo_pile with s - lo_pile with W0's gates) / (rho_shared x gap): the change's effect in nats on Pile rows as a share of its effect at the trigger
measurements.ratio_half: mean over the 20 draws of R_perm divided by the unshuffled R of the same half (down: down_pool)
measurements.survival: R_down / R_down_noclip: the share of the unclipped turned-down recovery (amendment 2's bins) left once no value may go below 0, i.e. once sign flips are removed

noise: seeds agree within 0.02 on the unshuffled R; amendment 2's shuffle sd 0.02 to 0.04; correlations over 73 to 106 windows have a chance spread of about 0.1 (c_null reported); 5 derangements
notation: g0(x), g1(x): W0's and the state's gates at the trigger of held-out window x; m0, m1: their means over the training windows; s = m1 - m0 on alive subcomponents (0 on dead), the fixed change; s_held: the same mean change over the held-out windows; s+ = max(s, 0) (turned up), s- = min(s, 0) (turned down); clip = clip to [0, 1]. Every pattern is W0's gates everywhere except the trigger position
